title: Mini Hoops
tagline: Pull back. Read the rim. Sink it before the clock does.
description: Pull-back mini basketball where one drag sets power, aim and arc together. Three games on one court: solo time attack against a moving rim, Floor Tic-Tac-Toe into nine real bins, and HORSE, where you place a bin or wall hoop as a target and the other player owes you the shot. Solo vs CPU, local hotseat, or signed-in online play with matchmaking and private rooms; the timed duel and HORSE run server-authoritative, tic-tac-toe is peer-relayed.
status: Playable - solo, local hotseat, and online 1v1 across three modes
